## Earthking Kaiju (CR 24)

**XP** 1,230,000  
NG Colossal outsider (earth, elemental, kaiju)  
**Init** -3 **Senses** darkvision 600 ft., tremorsense 300 ft.; Perception +0  


**Defense**


**AC** 21, touch 0, flat-footed 21 (-3 Dex, +22 natural, -8 size)  
**hp** 760 (31d10+589); **DR** 20/epic; fast healing 30  
**Fort** +17, **Ref** +7, **Will** +10  
**Immune** ability damage, ability drain, critical hits, death effects, disease, energy drain, mind-affecting effects, stunning, fire; **Resist** acid 30, cold 30, electricity 30, negative energy 30, sonic 15  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft.  
**Melee** two +43 slams (8d10+20 bludgeoning plus target is knocked prone (Fort DC 40 negates), 20/x5)  
**Ranged** +20 terraforce beam (3d6x10 force plus petrification (Fort DC 40 negates), 20/x2, 1,000 ft. range)  
**Special Attacks** hurl foe, massive, recovery  


**Statistics**


**Str** 50, **Dex** 4, **Con** 48, Int—, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +31; **CMB** +59; **CMD** 66 (cannot be tripped, bull rushed or repositioned)  
**Languages** understands Common (barely) but cannot speak  
**SQ** ferocity, freeze (a rocky cliff, mountain or other massive natural feature)  


**Special Abilities**


**Landbreaker Strike (Sp)** As a full-round action, an Earthking can pound both massive fists into the ground, creating an effect identical to earthquake cast by a 30th-level druid.  

**Protector of Children (Su)** The for all the Earthking’s might and instinct-driven savagery, the creature is fiercely protective of young humanoids, no matter the species. An Earthking’s destructive powers, including its earthquake and tectonic command abilities never harm any creature in the young adult or younger age categories.
